asl_grammar_rules.name: Topic / Comment
asl_grammar_rules.description: In a simple sentence, the topic is described first, followed by the comment. Facial signal: raised eyebrows + forward head tilt on topic.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Tense with Time Adverbs
asl_grammar_rules.description: Time adverbs (YESTERDAY, TODAY, TOMORROW, NOW) are placed at or near the beginning of a sentence to establish tense.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Simple Yes/No Questions
asl_grammar_rules.description: Short yes/no questions have variable sign order accompanied by raised eyebrows and head tilted forward.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Long Yes/No Questions
asl_grammar_rules.description: Longer yes/no questions use a Topic / Question format, placing the question sign at or near the end of the sentence.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Information-Seeking Questions (Wh-Questions)
asl_grammar_rules.description: Wh-questions (WHO, WHAT, WHEN, WHERE, WHY, WHICH, HOW) place the wh-sign at or near the end, accompanied by squeezed/furrowed eyebrows and head tilted forward.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Pronominalization & Spatial Indexing
asl_grammar_rules.description: Pronouns are indicated by pointing to a present referent or an established location point in 3D signing space.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Rhetorical Questions
asl_grammar_rules.description: The signer asks a question and immediately answers it (e.g. ME EXCITED WHY? NEXT-WEEK JAPAN me-FLY-to-there), using raised eyebrows.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Ordering of Simple Sentences
asl_grammar_rules.description: Simple sentences follow Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) or Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) order.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Conditional Sentences
asl_grammar_rules.description: In a conditional sentence, the condition is stated first (using SUPPOSE or IF with raised eyebrows and head tilt), followed by the outcome.

asl_grammar_rules.name: Negation
asl_grammar_rules.description: Negative thoughts are created by placing a negative sign (NOT, NEVER, NONE, CAN'T, DON'T-WANT) before the verb or at the end of the topic, accompanied by a negative headshake.
